2: To the chief Musician. Upon Muthlabben. A Psalm of David. I will praise Jehovah with my whole heart; I will recount all thy marvellous works.
3: I will be glad and rejoice in thee; I will sing forth thy name, O Most High.
4: When mine enemies turned back, they stumbled and perished at thy presence:
5: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause. Thou sittest on the throne, judging righteously.
6: Thou hast rebuked the nations, thou hast destroyed the wicked; thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
7: O enemy! destructions are ended for ever. — Thou hast also destroyed cities, even the remembrance of them hath perished.
8: But Jehovah sitteth for ever; he hath ordained his throne for judgment.
9: And it is he that will judge the world with righteousness; he shall execute judgment upon the peoples with equity.
10: And Jehovah will be a refuge to the oppressed one, a refuge in times of distress.
11: And they that know thy name will confide in thee; for thou, Jehovah, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
12: Sing psalms to Jehovah who dwelleth in Zion; tell among the peoples his doings.
13: For when he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them; the cry of the afflicted ones hath he not forgotten.
14: Be gracious unto me, O Jehovah; consider mine affliction from them that hate me, lifting me up from the gates of death:
15: That I may declare all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion. I will be joyful in thy salvation.
16: The nations are sunk down in the pit [that] they made; in the net that they hid is their own foot taken.
17: Jehovah is known [by] the judgment he hath executed: the wicked is ensnared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
18: The wicked shall be turned into Sheol, all the nations that forgetGod.
19: For the needy one shall not be forgotten alway; the hope of the meek shall not perish for ever.
20: Arise, Jehovah; let not man prevail: let the nations be judged in thy sight.
21: Put them in fear, Jehovah: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.
